attention_diagnostics.attention_formula: sum_(i<=t) sum_(r=0..4) c_r s_ti^r exp(-(t-i) lambda_tir) v_i; lambda_tir = exp(A_log_r) softplus(x_t w_query_r + x_i w_key_r + dt_bias_r); learned c (per_head) initialized at 1/r!; s_ti = Q_t K_i^T / sqrt(d_k); independent gates per layer/head/order, initialized by duplicating the shared gate; x is the pre-attention RMSNorm activation, then per-head RMSNorm over value channels with a learned gain
attention_diagnostics.attention_score_formula: exp(gamma_h) * <g_Q * q / sqrt(mean(q^2) + eps), g_K * k / sqrt(mean(k^2) + eps)> / sqrt(d_K); independent Q/K channel gains per layer, shared across heads; gamma_h learned independently per layer/head, initially zero
